name: allergens
description: Flags the allergens you choose on recipe previews. Custom words work for everyone; the 14 regulated allergens use the cook.md nutrition service (Cook Basic or Pro).

allergens.gluten.description: Flag gluten (wheat, rye, barley, oats). Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.crustaceans.description: Flag crustaceans. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.eggs.description: Flag eggs. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.fish.description: Flag fish. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.peanuts.description: Flag peanuts. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.soybeans.description: Flag soy. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.milk.description: Flag milk. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.treeNuts.description: Flag tree nuts (almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts…). Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.celery.description: Flag celery. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.mustard.description: Flag mustard. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.sesame.description: Flag sesame. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.sulphites.description: Flag sulphites. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.lupin.description: Flag lupin. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.molluscs.description: Flag molluscs. Needs Cook Basic or Pro.

allergens.custom.description: Other words to flag, matched against ingredient names (e.g. coriander). Plurals match both ways. Free for everyone.

allergens.showWhenLocked.description: When your plan doesn't include nutrition data, show a hint that the standard allergens can't be checked.
